cond_0001.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer prepares product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection. Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans. Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation. Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes. Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures. New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution. Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies. SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules. Coordinating validation activities with other departments. Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum of a bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering or Chemistry)
At least five (5) years of cleaning validation in a pharmaceutical operation or relevant experience

Ability to apply deductive reasoning and understand complicated issues

cond_0037.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer prepares product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0037.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection. Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans. Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation. Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes. Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures. New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution. Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies. SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules. Coordinating validation activities with other departments. Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.

Minimum of a bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering or Chemistry)

cond_0054.intro: We are looking for a Cleaning Validation Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer works with departments and personnel to prepare product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and works alongside others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0054.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Collaborating on the writing and reviewing of cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Coordinating execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection. Supporting adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans. Working with the team to prepare, review, and execute related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Coordinating the preparation and execution of cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Working with relevant teams to assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Coordinating with the Microbiology Lab on the assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation. Supporting development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes. Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures. New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution. Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies. SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Coordinating scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules. Coordinating validation activities with other departments. Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.

The Engineer owns preparation of product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include leading validation activities with departments and personnel and driving the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0224.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Write and review cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintain the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Execute cleaning validation protocol activities and direct sample collection. Take ownership of adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans. Prepare, review, and execute related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Prepare and execute cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Prepare risk assessments and reports summarizing data and determine cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Lead assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Drive investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and deliver documentation to support the findings of the investigation. Lead development projects when modifications are required and direct implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes. Prepare SOPs and deliver training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures. Generate and execute new cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ documents. Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies. Serve as SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Schedule, plan, and execute equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules. Lead validation activities with other departments. Apply experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.

cond_0251.intro: We are looking for a Cleaning Validation Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. You will own the preparation of product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports, and procedural documentation. You will lead coordination of validation activities with departments and personnel and take ownership of maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, you will direct and instruct others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0251.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Lead the writing and reviewing of cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintain the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Execute cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection. Ensure adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans. Prepare, review, and execute related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Prepare and execute cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Prepare risk assessments and reports summarizing data and determining cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Direct the assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Lead investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and deliver documentation to support investigation findings. Drive development projects when modifications are required and implement new cleaning equipment/processes. Prepare SOPs and deliver training to staff on the cleaning validation approach and procedures. Own new cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution. Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies. Serve as SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Schedule, plan, and execute equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules. Lead coordination of validation activities with other departments. Apply experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0251.requirements:
Minimum of a bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering or Chemistry)
At least five (5) years of cleaning validation in a pharmaceutical operation or relevant experience
Keeps abreast of current developments and trends in areas of expertise
Ability to independently write clear and concise technical reports, process descriptions, and standard operating procedures

Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection. Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans. Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation. Leading development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes. Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach and procedures. New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution. Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies. SME for documentation and reporting of cleaning validation findings to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning, and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules. Coordinating validation activities with other departments as required by project milestones. Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.

The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer works with departments and personnel to prepare product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and works alongside others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0324.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Collaborating on the writing and reviewing of cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Coordinating execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection. Supporting adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans. Working with the team to prepare, review, and execute related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Coordinating the preparation and execution of cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Working with relevant teams to assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Coordinating with the Microbiology Lab on the assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation. Supporting development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes. Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures. New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution. Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies. SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Coordinating scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules. Coordinating validation activities with other departments. Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0324.requirements:
Minimum of a bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering or Chemistry)
At least five (5) years of cleaning validation in a pharmaceutical operation or relevant experience

Coordinate with the team on writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and help maintain the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Support execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection. Work with relevant stakeholders to ensure adherence to FDA guidance, regulatory requirements, and client Validation Master Plans. Collaborate on preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Work alongside colleagues to prepare and execute cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Coordinate preparation of risk assessments and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Work with the team to assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Collaborate with the Microbiology Lab on assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Assist in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities, and contribute documentation to support investigation findings. Support development projects when modifications are required and help implement new cleaning equipment and processes. Prepare SOPs and provide training to staff on cleaning validation approach and procedures. Contribute to new cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ, and PQ document generation and execution. Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies. Serve as SME and coordinate with Regulatory (FDA), internal, and external auditors on cleaning validation matters.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Coordinate scheduling, planning, and execution of equipment and process qualifications to meet approved schedules. Work with other departments to align validation activities. Apply experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.

cond_0362.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer prepares product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0362.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection. Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans. Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation. Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes. Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures. New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution. Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies. SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules. Coordinating validation activities with other departments. Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.

Responsibilities include regularly coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, and procedures, and actively leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0429.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection. Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans. Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Actively participating in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities, communicating findings and providing documentation to support the investigation. Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes. Preparing SOPs and providing regular training to staff on the cleaning validation approach and procedures. New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution. Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies. SME for presenting and explaining cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors, walking them through findings and handling questions directly.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules. Coordinating validation activities with other departments on an ongoing basis. Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
cond_0429.requirements:
Minimum of a bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. Microbiology, Biology, Engineering or Chemistry)
At least five (5) years of cleaning validation in a pharmaceutical operation or relevant experience
Keeps abreast of current developments and trends in areas of expertise
Ability to independently write clear and concise technical reports, process descriptions, and standard operating procedures

The Engineer prepares product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports, and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, and procedures, and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0457.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection. Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans. Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Assessing new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation. Leading development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes. Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach and procedures. New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution. Performing periodic cleaning validation verification studies. SME for documentation and reporting of cleaning validation findings to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning, and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules. Coordinating validation activities with other departments as required by project milestones. Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.

cond_0467.intro: We are looking for a Cleaning Validation Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. You will own the preparation of product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports, and procedural documentation. You will lead coordination of validation activities with departments and personnel and take ownership of maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, you will direct and instruct others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0467.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Lead the writing and reviewing of cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintain the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Execute cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection. Ensure adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans. Prepare, review, and execute related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Prepare and execute cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Prepare risk assessments and reports summarizing data and determining cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Direct the assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Lead investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and deliver documentation to support investigation findings. Drive development projects when modifications are required and implement new cleaning equipment/processes. Prepare SOPs and deliver training to staff on the cleaning validation approach and procedures. Own new cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution. Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies. Serve as SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Schedule, plan, and execute equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules. Lead coordination of validation activities with other departments. Apply experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.

cond_0543.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer prepares product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0543.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection. Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans. Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation. Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes. Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures. New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution. Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies. SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules. Coordinating validation activities with other departments. Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.

cond_0553.intro: The successful candidate is an SME in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation and has knowledge of equipment and process validation. The Engineer prepares product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports and procedural documentation. Responsibilities include coordinating validation activities with departments and personnel and maintaining the cleaning validation processes and procedures. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, procedures and leads and instructs others supporting cleaning validation deliverables. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of cleaning validation concepts and how they apply across equipment and processes.
cond_0553.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and maintaining the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection. Responsible for adherence to FDA guidance and regulatory requirements and client Validation Master Plans. Preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Preparing and executing cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Preparing risk assessment and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols with Microbiology Lab for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Assisting in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities and providing documentation to support the findings of the investigation. Lead development projects when modifications are required and implementation of new cleaning equipment/processes. Preparing SOPs and providing training to staff on the cleaning validation approach procedures. New cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ document generation and execution. Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies. SME for presentation of cleaning validation to Regulatory (FDA), internal and external auditors.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Scheduling, planning and execution of equipment and process qualifications meeting approved schedules. Coordinating validation activities with other departments. Experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.

cond_0621.intro: The successful candidate is a subject matter expert in cleaning and sanitization effectiveness validation with knowledge of equipment and process validation. Working closely with departments and personnel, this role involves preparing product contact surface cleaning and room and equipment sanitization effectiveness validation, process and equipment validation protocols, protocol final reports, and procedural documentation. As the cleaning validation SME, the candidate is knowledgeable in cleaning validation concepts, practices, and procedures, and helps coordinate and support others contributing to cleaning validation deliverables.
cond_0621.responsibilities:
Cleaning Validation Responsibilities
Coordinate with the team on writing and reviewing cleaning and sanitization procedures and help maintain the Cleaning Validation Master Plan. Support execution of cleaning validation protocol activities and sample collection. Work with relevant stakeholders to ensure adherence to FDA guidance, regulatory requirements, and client Validation Master Plans. Collaborate on preparing, reviewing, and executing related validation studies such as extraction and recovery studies for product contact surfaces and equipment surfaces. Work alongside colleagues to prepare and execute cleaning development protocols including lab scale, full scale spray coverage testing, and full-scale cleaning recipe and procedure development. Coordinate preparation of risk assessments and reports summarizing data and determination of cleaning matrix and critical cleaning parameters for validation. Work with the team to assess new products being introduced to the site for alignment within the approved cleaning matrix. Collaborate with the Microbiology Lab on assessment, preparation, and execution of sanitization effectiveness study protocols for active and new sanitizing agents on room and work surfaces. Assist in investigations, i.e., deviations during the execution of protocols and/or continuous monitoring activities, and contribute documentation to support investigation findings. Support development projects when modifications are required and help implement new cleaning equipment and processes. Prepare SOPs and provide training to staff on cleaning validation approach and procedures. Contribute to new cleaning equipment URS, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ, and PQ document generation and execution. Perform periodic cleaning validation verification studies. Serve as SME and coordinate with Regulatory (FDA), internal, and external auditors on cleaning validation matters.
Equipment and Process Validation Responsibilities
Coordinate scheduling, planning, and execution of equipment and process qualifications to meet approved schedules. Work with other departments to align validation activities. Apply experience with Equipment and Instrument Standards used for validation executions.
